content:
sara: Quick run of A100 vs H100 inference sweep across us-west1 and eu-central1. Put charts + raw CSV in the gist: https://gist.github.com/rw-infer/bench-1769043210. TL;DR: H100 gives ~1.7-2x decode throughput vs A100 for our common 7B/13B open models; prefill gains are smaller (~1.2x). Kernel choice (fused_kv vs cutlass) matters more on A100. Quant to 4-bit cuts mem but sometimes adds 5-12% decode latency on A100.

rahul: Nice. Can you paste the key numbers (tokens/sec and $/1M tokens) for Llama-2-13B and Mistral-7B? Also what batch/seq you used?

morgan: Sure — quick summary (batch=1, seq_prefill=1024, seq_decode=256, decode temp=0.2). Numbers are median of 10 runs, us-west1 / eu-central1 diff included.

morgan: ```
Model             | GPU   | prefill (ms) | decode (ms/token) | toks/sec | $ / 1M toks (GPU-only)
Llama-2-13B       | A100  | 420          | 5.6               | 180      | $36
Llama-2-13B       | H100  | 260          | 3.1               | 345      | $22
Mistral-7B        | A100  | 210          | 2.1               | 480      | $14
Mistral-7B        | H100  | 130          | 1.1               | 910      | $8
Notes: us-west1 ~4-6% faster than eu-central1 for decode due to network & image cold starts. Quant-4bit on A100: ~+8% decode latency on 13B, tokens/sec down ~10% but memory footprint halved.```

rahul: Good numbers — what's the kernel breakdown? I vaguely remember fused_kv helps H100 more?

morgan: Kernel wins: fused_kv (our fused attention + kv cache kernel) is +20-40% on H100 for decode-heavy workloads vs vanilla cutlass/cuBLAS. On A100 fused_kv helps but gains smaller (~10-15%) because memory bandwidth + tensor core shapes. For prefill, GEMM-heavy paths dominate so kernel selection less dramatic.

bench-bot: Automated note: full benchmark artifacts -> s3://redwood-bench/1769043210/ (csv, flamegraphs, perf traces).

sara: For capacity planning: if product needs 1k sustained tok/s for 13B (mixed request shape), what's a good Dedicated pool config?

morgan: Rule of thumb from these runs: 1 H100 (single) ~345 toks/sec decode for 13B at batch=1. Accounting for variability and 20% headroom, plan ~250 toks/sec effective. So for 1k tok/s decode you'd need ~4 H100s. For A100 you'd plan for ~7-8 GPUs (using 180 toks/sec -> plan 125 eff). If you want redundancy + can use batching (batch=4) throughput increases ~1.6-2x, so you can reduce counts accordingly.

rahul: How about cost math for hosted pricing estimate (GPU-only) — you used which hourly rates?

morgan: I used list rates: A100 = $2.7/hr, H100 = $4.5/hr (region avg we use for these calc). Cost per 1M toks = (1M / toks_per_sec) / 3600 * hourly_rate. That's where the numbers come from. Not including infra egress or control-plane.

sara: Any odd regressions in quality with quant on H100? We saw in past certain models had small generation quality drops when switching quant libs.

morgan: Quick eval on our holdout promptset (50 prompts) — quant-4bit for Mistral-7B had negligible quality drop (<= 1% on our BLEU/ROUGE-like pass rate). Llama-2-13B saw a slightly higher regression (~3-4%) on long-context completions (likely due to quantized KV accumulation). Flagged in the eval dashboard. Recommend gated rollout + A/B.

sara: OK — next steps: 1) add a canary config for H100 fused_kv in eu region, 2) add quant-4bit Mistral to staging with eval hooks, 3) update Dedicated capacity docs with the new rule-of-thumb. I'll create tickets.

rahul: thanks — can you paste the exact command you ran so infra can reproduce?

morgan: ```bash
./bench/run_bench.py --models "llama-2-13b,mistral-7b" --gpus "a100,h100" --regions "us-west1,eu-central1" --batch-sizes "1,4" --prefill-length 1024 --decode-length 256 --runs 10 --kernels "cutlass,fused_kv" --quant "none,4bit" --out s3://redwood-bench/1769043210/
```

sara: perfect. i'm going to file the canary ticket and link the gist + s3. thanks all :rocket:
